items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Sandy Williams came to New York, permanently, to join this band.

ctx.x: Here's something that might be interesting to talk about. Let's see. It's -- I'm not sure -- oh, yeah, this is November, 1930. It says, "Sandy Williams came to New York, permanently, to join this band. He recalled that the Dunbar was hired out to different clubs each night. If Fletcher was indeed cooperating with some of his special arrangements, meaning that he was providing some of his arrangements to you, which I think you did tell me that the first day. "If Fletcher was indeed cooperating with some of his…
charts onto their own manuscript paper. Of course, they would never those borrowed arrangements when Fletcher himself was listening." Do you have any comment about that?
